newsitem.title: USA: ILC Technology sees gain from unit sale.
newsitem.headline: ILC Technology sees gain from unit sale.

text.p: ILC Technology Inc on Friday said it expects to report a gain in the June quarter on the sale of its unit, Converter Power Inc, to Applied Science and Technology Inc.
ILC sold the unit for $6.35 million in cash and 45,000 shares of Applied Science stock, subject to closing cost adjustments.
ILC did not disclose the size of its expected gain.
Earlier ILC, a maker of high-performance lighting systems, reported a $0.14 per share profit in its fiscal second quarter ended March 29 versus a restated $0.23 a share last year.
Year ago earnings were restated to reflect discontinued operations.

"Our outlook for the balance of fiscal 1997 and beyond is strong," Richard Capra, president, said. "Backlogs in our continuing product lines are at an all-time high and up from the same period last year by approximately 50 percent."

Finally, ILC said its divestiture of Precision Lamp Inc, announced in November 1996, has also been completed at a price of $4.0 million payable to the company over three years. ILC said the purchase price, net of expenses, will approximate Precision Lamp's book value.
